webLinks.linkText: Road network impacts - Port of Newcastle to Central West

properties.otherAdvice:
Oversize and Overmass (OSOM) deliveries are underway. The 80-metre long wind turbine blades are being transported from the Port of Newcastle to the Uungula Wind Farm development near Wellington in the Central West Orana. Multiple OSOM movements will leave each week, although the number may vary. 

The blade components are scheduled to leave the Port at night time to minimise impacts around the Newcastle precinct. These vehicles are then expected to be travelling between Warkworth and Wellington during daylight hours.

Traffic may be held, or there may be delays at the following key locations:

  • The intersection of John Renshaw Dr and Hunter Expressway
  • Golden Hwy at Mount Thorley, Denman, Merriwa and Saxa Road
  • Mitchell Hwy onto Goolma Rd
  • Goolma Rd and Twelve Mile Rd

Motorists are urged to slow down and exercise caution when approaching or passing an OSOM load.

properties.otherAdvice: Expect intermittent closures during vehicle recovery.

There is an Oversize Overmass (OSOM) vehicle travelling from the Queensland border on Thursday 15 October through to Merriwa on Sunday 18 October.

The OSOM vehicle will be carrying a transformer which is about 6.5 metres wide and 140 metres long. 

Over the four days the OSOM load will travel through Narrabri, Coonabarabran and Ballimore before reaching the Five Mile rest area, west of Merriwa.

Traffic delays are expected on Sunday 18 October on the Golden Highway as the load reaches Dunedoo and Merriwa.

Motorists are advised to plan their journey, allow extra travel time and adhere to any direction given by traffic controllers and/or pilot vehicles.

Motorists are urged to slow down and exercise caution when approaching or passing an OSOM load.
Emergency services are directing motorists through the breakdown lane.
